Longitude difference $= 151 - 16 = 135^\circ$

Time difference $= 135 \div 15 = 9$ hrs

Sydney is 9 hrs ahead.

$\therefore$ Time in Sydney is 2 am Friday.

Equation: $y = 3.2x + 2$

Using calculator with points: $A = 2$, $B = 3.2$, so $y = 3.2x + 2$.

notes: Oakhill College Year 12 Mathematics Standard 2 Task 3 Past Papers Test 2022 (labelled AT3). Bundled solutions (pages 13-21) are the teacher's handwritten worked solutions with MCQ answers circled; no separate marking criteria so marks_breakdown is null. Typos in the handwritten solutions: Q9(c) line '50m = 42750 - (35x65)' should read 4275; Q9(c) 'm = $40' has a stray dollar sign; Q7 gives '0.231 km = 232 m' (0.2317 km rounds to 232 m). Q13(a) solution says 'Several alternatives (see guidelines)' but no further guidelines are provided. Q9 text 'basic fitness mat ($C)' printed as is. Tables in Q12 and Q15 are images and are cropped as figures. Question 4 hourglass is a decorative photo. Reference sheet and answer sheet pages skipped.
